title: Drops After the Operation

patient.name: Mdm Chua Mei Ling
patient.presenting_complaint: Post cataract surgery — needs her antibiotic and steroid eye drops instilled and technique taught

history.hpc: Mdm Chua says 'I just did my cataract operation, doctor give me eye drops but I don't know how to put properly.' She needs her post-op drops instilled into the operated right eye and to be taught the technique for home.
history.pmhx: Recent right cataract surgery. No drug allergies on file (confirm).
history.social_hx: Lives with her daughter who can help with drops at home.

iop.right: Not the focus of this station
iop.left: Not the focus of this station

examination_findings.anterior_segment: Recent surgical eye — handle gently, no pressure on the globe

investigations.task: Instil the charted post-op drops into the correct (operated) eye with correct, gentle technique and teach the patient for home use
investigations.key_points: Confirm identity, correct eye and the drop name/strength; check allergy; no-touch technique into the lower fornix; gentle closure and nasolacrimal pressure; avoid pressure on the operated eye

diagnosis: Post-operative drops instilled safely into the correct operated eye using a gentle no-touch technique after confirming identity, the correct eye, the drop and allergy status. The patient is taught the technique for home and the importance of hand hygiene around a recently operated eye. This is a procedural/teaching station.

immediate: Confirm identity, the operated (right) eye and the charted drop name and strength
Check for drug/eye-drop allergy before instilling
Perform hand hygiene and avoid any pressure on the operated globe
Tilt the head back, pull the lower lid down and instil one drop into the lower fornix without touching the eye or lashes
Ask the patient to close gently and apply light pressure near the nose
If more than one drop is charted, wait a few minutes between them
Document the drops given, eye, time and allergy check
follow_up: Confirm the home drop schedule and who will help instil them
Advise reporting increasing pain, redness or reduced vision urgently
patient_education: Teach the head-back, lower-lid-pocket technique in simple language
Stress hand hygiene before touching a recently operated eye
Explain to space out different drops and not to rub the eye
